en: The Philippines has a total land area of roughly 300,000 square kilometers, which is much larger than the US state of Arizona.
The Philippine Senate has exactly 24 members, while the House of Representatives has over 300 district and party-list representatives.
Spain colonized the Philippines for 333 years, starting with Miguel López de Legazpi's arrival in 1565 until the Treaty of Paris in 1898.
The Philippines has over 180 distinct living languages, but Filipino and English are the only two official languages used in government.
The Lumad people comprise about 18 distinct indigenous ethnolinguistic groups living mainly in the Mindanao region of the Philippines.
The Philippine eagle has a massive wingspan of up to 2 meters, making it one of the largest and rarest eagles globally.
The Philippines is an archipelago consisting of 7,641 islands, which is 534 more islands than the previously counted 7,107 total.
Jose Rizal was only 35 years old when he was executed, having written exactly two famous novels, Noli Me Tangere and El Filibusterismo.
Dr. Fe del Mundo invented a bamboo incubator in 1955 that kept babies warm at 37 degrees Celsius without using electricity.
Mount Apo is the highest peak in the Philippines, standing at exactly 2,954 meters above sea level in the Davao region.
Filipino citizens gain the right to vote in national elections at exactly 18 years of age, without any literacy or property requirements.
Juan Luna’s famous painting Spoliarium measures exactly 4.22 meters by 7.64 meters, making it one of the largest canvases in Philippine art.
